nodes.label: Raw-First Ingestion Pipeline Documentation
nodes.description: Documents the implemented durable ingestion path. Entry contracts: POST /api/ingestion/events (middleware ingestion.token, persists raw receipt + outbox, returns 201 received), POST /api/sensors/{sensor}/readings (API key, creates reading directly), MQTT (ingestion_service validates and forwards). Durable path: IngestionController → MySQL (raw_sensor_events + raw_event_outboxes) → Debezium binlog capture → iot-cdc.* streams → cdc:consume-outboxes → iot.raw-events → raw:consume (normalizes readings, updates raw_sensor_events status) → domain_event_outboxes → Debezium → iot.domain-events → domain:consume → Pusher-compatible broadcast. Consumer groups: raw-process-v1, browser-delivery-v1, email-delivery-v1. Processes: cdc:consume-outboxes --block=5000, raw:consume --block=5000, domain:consume --block=5000.
nodes.rationale: The authoritative document for the ingestion pipeline. Defines the exact flow from ingestion to browser delivery, the consumer groups, the persistence states, and the process commands. Supersedes any earlier pipeline descriptions.
